title: SimpleSign playbook
description: Sections of TestBench steps (signatures to make or refuse, files to validate) and what each must show. Load it in the TestBench (Playbook tab).

title.description: Title of the playbook and of the evidence.

format.description: Format of steps that name none.

crossValidate.description: Whether EU DSS also validates every file a step produces, next to SimpleSign (default false). When DSS is unavailable the step still runs and its result says so.

options.description: Options under each step's: common (every format), then pades, cades or xades.

common.description: TestBench run options (see docs/playbooks/options.md). Symbolic values: sandbox:SIGNER (a Sandbox signer), sample:ID (a sample document), preset:KIND:NAME (a built-in policy), playbook:ID (a policy declared in policies), step:ID (the file an earlier step signed). A validation takes { fileId, dataId?, settings? }.

pades.description: TestBench run options (see docs/playbooks/options.md). Symbolic values: sandbox:SIGNER (a Sandbox signer), sample:ID (a sample document), preset:KIND:NAME (a built-in policy), playbook:ID (a policy declared in policies), step:ID (the file an earlier step signed). A validation takes { fileId, dataId?, settings? }.

cades.description: TestBench run options (see docs/playbooks/options.md). Symbolic values: sandbox:SIGNER (a Sandbox signer), sample:ID (a sample document), preset:KIND:NAME (a built-in policy), playbook:ID (a policy declared in policies), step:ID (the file an earlier step signed). xades.description: TestBench run options (see docs/playbooks/options.md). Symbolic values: sandbox:SIGNER (a Sandbox signer), sample:ID (a sample document), preset:KIND:NAME (a built-in policy), playbook:ID (a policy declared in policies), step:ID (the file an earlier step signed). A validation takes { fileId, dataId?, settings? }.

policies.description: Policies the steps adjust (a built-in one with some constraints changed).

items.description: A policy the playbook adjusts, named playbook:ID by signingPolicyId or validation.policyId.

base.description: The policy it starts from: default or a built-in name (iofe, strict…).

set.description: The constraints changed, by path (SigningCertificate/KeyUsage), each as the policy file writes it: { "Level": "FAIL", "Id": ["nonRepudiation"] }.

sandbox.description: The Sandbox state for the step; put back after it.

revoke.description: Certificates to revoke for the step.

expect.description: What the run must show; every field given is checked, for each engine.

outcome.description: signed / refused (SigningException) / error, or the verdict valid / invalid / indeterminate.

indication.description: ETSI indication of the first signature.

failedConstraints.description: Constraints of the validation policy that must fail, by name, in the signature or what it carries (a time-stamp, revocation data).

qualification.description: The qualification of the first signature under the profile's framework (eIDAS: QESig, QESeal, AdESig-QC, AdESeal-QC, AdESig, AdESeal, Indeterminate …, Not AdES, N/A).

timestampQualification.description: The qualification of its first timestamp: QTSA (qualified electronic time-stamp), TSA or N/A.

etsiReport.description: valid: the run's ETSI TS 119 102-2 validation report must be valid against its schema (embedded in SimpleSign).

dssAgrees.description: Whether EU DSS must agree with SimpleSign. Needs crossValidate on the step or in the defaults, and a run that produces a file (a refusal is never sent to DSS); when DSS is unavailable this check fails.

logContains.description: Texts the run's log must contain.

step.description: One run and what it must show.

id.description: Unique id; step:ID names the file it signed.

description.description: What the step shows and why.

tags.description: Free labels (a requirement id, a topic): the page filters by them, the evidence groups by them.

kind.description: What the step does. Default: sign.

format.description: Format of a signature; the default's when absent.

crossValidate.description: Whether EU DSS also validates the file this step produces; overrides defaults.crossValidate.

wait.description: Seconds to wait before the step runs, before its Sandbox changes (a short-lived certificate that must expire, a revocation that must come after a time-stamp).

options.description: TestBench run options (see docs/playbooks/options.md). Symbolic values: sandbox:SIGNER (a Sandbox signer), sample:ID (a sample document), preset:KIND:NAME (a built-in policy), playbook:ID (a policy declared in policies), step:ID (the file an earlier step signed). A validation takes { fileId, dataId?, settings? }.
